title: Rival Appears
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing lowered her voice and whispered in his ear: "Behind Ling Yuan... stands the Holy Sect."

text.content: Before the third morning bell had faded, the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena was already filled with a sea of dark figures. Today was the day for the Outer Disciples' quarterly assessment. In previous years, it was merely a formality, but this year had become uniquely different because of a name—Chen Ji. That waste of a servant who had accidentally entered the forbidden grounds in the Spiritual Mine half a month ago and miraculously survived. The crowd whispered, their gazes occasionally sweeping over the frail figure in the corner, speculation and mockery intertwining into a cacophony of noise. Ling Yuan stood with hands clasped behind his back on the high platform, his clouded old eyes sweeping across all living beings, finally fixing on Chen Ji, a meaningful arc curling at the corner of his lips.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji?" Ling Yuan descended slowly from the platform, his voice calm yet penetrating everyone's ears. "I heard you had quite the luck, surviving the Spiritual Mine." He stopped three steps from Chen Ji, gazing down at the youth who was two heads shorter than himself. "Luck, you see... diminishes with each use."

text.content: Silence fell instantly. Ling Yuan's words were casually spoken, yet they labeled Chen Ji as a cockroach surviving by sheer luck. Everyone present caught the undertone—a waste is still a waste, and today's assessment would prove it. Several Outer Disciples snickered, with some deliberately discussing loudly: "The old Sect Master personally inquired, Chen Ji will probably embarrass himself today." Chen Ji lowered his eyes, his expression flatly calm, almost numb, only his hidden fingers in his sleeves slightly curling.

dialogue.content: "What? Scared stupid?" A core disciple beside Ling Yuan spoke with veiled mockery. "I'd advise you to kneel and concede early, to avoid embarrassing yourself during the assessment. Your pathetic cultivation is even worse than Wang Er who ranks last among outer disciples, yet you dare stand here with a bold face?" He deliberately emphasized "last" with heavy stress, drawing a burst of laughter from those around. Ling Yuan did not intervene, merely watching Chen Ji with interest, waiting to see how he would react.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, his gaze shifting from Ling Yuan to the mocking core disciple before lowering again. His lips parted, but no sound emerged—this hesitant gesture appeared as utter cowardice in the crowd's eyes. Yet only Chen Ji himself comprehended the rapid calculations spinning in his mind: Ling Yuan's spiritual energy fluctuation hinted at late Foundation Building stage, while the core disciple barely reached early Foundation Building. Both displayed hidden injuries in their qi circulation, revealing unstable foundations. A cold smile formed in Chen Ji's heart as he contemplated the old man's true motives.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan publicly humiliated Chen Ji—how should he respond?

choices.text: Endure with bowed head, preserve strength
choices.description: Make no rebuttal,任由对方嘲讽，保持废物人设不被打破，伺机观察凌渊真正目的。
choices.risk_hint: 若表现太过窝囊，可能影响后续名望和盟友判断

text.content: Chen Ji's lips trembled slightly as he bowed his head, voice thin as a mosquito's: "The senior is absolutely right... this disciple was wrong." His shoulders hunched slightly, his entire being resembling a withered blade of grass bent by wind and rain. Another burst of laughter erupted around him, someone even spitting in his direction. Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, examining him for a moment, seemingly satisfied with this reaction, and turned to leave.

choices.text: Cold verbal counterattack, retreat to advance
choices.description: 看似示弱实则绵里藏针，用言语刺激对方露出更多破绽，让围观者看出端倪。
choices.risk_hint: 若把握不好分寸，可能被凌渊抓住把柄

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze calm yet hollow: "The senior's教训 is correct. This disciple indeed merely had good luck." He paused, the corners of his mouth lifting slightly: "However... luck sometimes turns to others as well." Spoken lightly, yet it caused Ling Yuan's eyes to sharpen. He hadn't expected a废物 servant to dare speak to him in such a tone. Someone on the high platform exclaimed in a low voice: "This kid has gone mad!"

As the atmosphere reached a standoff, a cold voice came from behind the crowd: "This is the Tianqing Sect's hospitality—letting a bunch of ants surround a废物?" Everyone turned to look, parting the crowd to reveal a woman in black纱 approaching slowly. Her face was beautiful yet haunting, surrounded by wisps of black mist that made the air grow colder with each step. Ling Yuan's pupils constricted sharply: "Someone from the Holy Sect's demonic path?" Ye Qing's lips curled in mockery, her gaze sweeping past Ling Yuan before landing on Chen Ji: "So the leader of the righteous path treats others with strength to bully the weak?"

dialogue.content: Ye Qing walked to Chen Ji's side, confronting Ling Yuan from ten paces away. Her presence was like an unfathomable abyss—merely standing there, yet exerting immense pressure on everyone present. "This... senior?" she deliberately stressed "senior" with deliberate lightness. "I have old grudges to settle with him. Please, be so kind as to step aside." Ling Yuan's eyelids twitched: "What grudges?" Ye Qing laughed lightly, her laughter like silver bells yet carrying bone-piercing cold: "A blood feud of killing my father—does the senior wish to meddle in such a trivial matter?"

text.content: At these words, the entire arena erupted. The Holy Sect's Sacred Maiden actually had a kill-father grudge with Tianqing Sect's废物 servant? Everyone looked at each other, finding it utterly absurd. Ling Yuan's face darkened. Before he could speak, Ye Qing had already turned to Chen Ji, her tone suddenly cold: "Chen Ji, do you think hiding in Tianqing Sect can keep you alive? Today I give you two choices—either publicly renounce your cultivation, or... come with me." Her gaze was ice-cold, yet her lips carried a meaning others could not comprehend. Chen Ji understood in his heart: this was cooperating with his act.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stepped back, a look of terror on his face: "You... don't come closer!" His voice trembled, his acting skills impeccable. Ye Qing pressed forward step by step, black mist spreading beneath her feet, enveloping both of them. Ling Yuan frowned, about to intervene, when Ye Qing suddenly lowered her voice, swiftly slipping something into Chen Ji's hand while whispering in his ear: "After we finish the act tonight, at the Stone Forest in the Back Mountain at midnight." The words came so fast they were barely audible. Finished, she abruptly stepped back three paces and declared loudly: "Today I shall spare your life!"

text.content: The black mist dissipated, and Ye Qing had vanished at the entrance of the Martial Arena. The crowd emerged from their daze, exchanging glances. Ling Yuan stared at Chen Ji, a complex light flickering in his eyes. How many secrets did this废物 servant still conceal? He summoned a trusted disciple and instructed in a low voice: "Investigate the connection between this Chen Ji and the Holy Sect. If there are any unusual movements..." He didn't finish, but the disciple understood perfectly and departed on his orders. Chen Ji stood in place with bowed head, shoulders trembling slightly, appearing completely unnerved. Only he himself knew that gripped tightly in his palm was the item Ye Qing had slipped him—a black token carved with intricate patterns.

choice.prompt: After the assessment, what should Chen Ji do?

choices.text: Keep the appointment on time and find out Ye Qing's intentions
choices.description: Follow the token's directions to the Back Mountain Stone Grove, secretly meet with Ye Qing, and understand why she wants to help him and the truth behind Ling Yuan's forces.
choices.visible_reward: Gain key intelligence and strong ally support
choices.risk_hint: If followed by Ling Yuan's men, may fall into danger

text.content: At the Hour of the Rat, the moon hidden behind clouds. Chen Ji moved through the mountain paths like a specter, avoiding patrolling disciples, arriving silently at the Back Mountain Stone Grove. Ye Qing had been waiting for some time, and upon seeing him arrive, a hint of surprise flickered in her eyes: 'You actually dare to come?' Chen Ji did not answer, merely tossing the black token back to her: 'Speak, what's the matter?' Ye Qing pocketed the token, her expression turning grave: 'Ling Yuan... he is not an ordinary Foundation Building cultivator.'

choices.description: Don't rush to the appointment. First use the Tianji Record Fragment to peer into Ling Yuan's recent movements, confirm whether Ye Qing's words are true, then decide.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence on Ling Yuan's weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: Each use of the Tianji Record consumes 5 points of Heavenly Fate

text.content: Back at his dwelling, Chen Ji locked the door, sat cross-legged on the bed. He took out the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest, fingertips gently stroking the yellowed page. A mysterious power surged from the fragment, drilling into his brow center. In an instant, blurry images flashed through his mind—Ling Yuan kneeling before a black-robed figure, his posture humble, nothing like a sect master's. Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, pupils shaking violently: though vague, the Tianji Record's displayed scene proved one thing: someone else stood behind Ling Yuan!

choices.text: Stay put and observe the situation
choices.description: Don't actively contact Ye Qing, nor use the Tianji Record. Continue maintaining the useless personae, wait for the other party's next move.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to obtain intelligence
choices.visible_reward: Don't consume any resources, maintain the original pace
choices.risk_hint: May cause Ye Qing to think she was rejected, losing a potential ally

text.content: Chen Ji secured the token, deciding to stay put for now. Since Ye Qing had taken the initiative to make contact, it meant she had her own schemes. Rather than rush to the appointment and expose his intentions, it was better to observe quietly and see how she would play her next card. He closed his eyes, silently deducing: Ling Yuan's probing today would surely be followed by more moves. Instead of passively reacting, better to respond to changes with constancy. However, he hadn't anticipated that Ye Qing was no one to sit and wait.

The next morning, as Chen Ji was splitting firewood in the kitchen, Su Qingyao's figure suddenly appeared at the door. The Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, the number one talent of the same generation in the Tianqing Sect, usually had eyes only for the heavens and never set foot in Outer Disciple territory. Today, she broke convention, carrying a food container in her hand. 'Chen Ji.' Her voice was cold and clear, but her gaze carried scrutiny: 'I saw everything that happened at the Martial Arena yesterday.' Chen Ji stopped his work, smiling simplistically: 'Senior Sister Su, is there something you need?' Su Qingyao set the food container before him: 'Stop pretending. Why would a demonic path saint help you?'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji scratched his head, wearing a look of confusion: 'Disciple doesn't know either... That demonic woman suddenly appeared, said she wanted revenge, but disciple doesn't know her at all.' He blinked, expression utterly innocent: 'Maybe she mistook someone? After all, with disciple being such useless trash, who would have grudges with me?' Su Qingyao stared at him for a long while, seemingly trying to find any crack in his expression. But Chen Ji's acting was too perfect—that honest, simple appearance was airtight. In the end, she could only coldly snort: 'You'd better not be lying to me.' When she turned to leave, her pace was noticeably slower than when she came.

text.content: After Su Qingyao was far gone, the simple smile on Chen Ji's face gradually faded, replaced by a deep, grave expression. He opened the food container—inside were several delicate pastries, and at the very bottom was pressed a note: 'Ling Yuan will secretly meet the Xuanwu Sect envoy tonight, location—the abandoned alchemy chamber at East Peak. If you want to know why he's targeting you, arrive before the Hour of the Rat.' After reading, Chen Ji held the note near the candle flame, watching it turn to ash. Though unsigned, he had already guessed who left it—Su Qingyao was clearly also investigating Ling Yuan, just from a different direction than himself. A slight smile curved his lips: Interesting, it seems this chess game is more complex than imagined.

dialogue.content: In the deep of night, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly emitted a faint glow. Chen Ji took out the fragment, and an aged voice resounded in his mind: 'Boy, you revealed yourself today.' It was Master Mo. Chen Ji frowned: 'Revealed what?' Master Mo's voice carried a warning: 'That demonic path saint's appearance was too deliberate. Ling Yuan has grown suspicious. He will next use sect secret arts to investigate your connection to the demonic path.' Chen Ji's heart tensed: 'Is there a way to resolve this?' Master Mo was silent for a moment: '...The Tianji Record can conceal aura, but each concealment, you know the price.'

choice.prompt: Master Mo proposed using the Tianji Record to conceal aura. What choice should Chen Ji make?

choices.text: Consume Heavenly Fate to conceal aura
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record ability to completely sever Ling Yuan's trail of investigation, ensuring that your connection to the Demonic Path remains undiscovered.
choices.visible_reward: Completely eliminate the risk of being investigated
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is extremely precious, difficult to replenish once consumed

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate, spreading the fragment across his palm. Mystical runes surfaced from the page, transforming into golden light that merged into his brow center. In that instant, the air around him seemed enveloped by some unseen force, becoming ethereal and elusive. Master Mo's voice echoed once more: "Your aura is concealed. For three days, no one will be able to trace you. But remember—debts will always be repaid." Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, his gaze profound and penetrating. "I know."

choices.text: Do not conceal, seek another method
choices.description: Retain Heavenly Fate, and handle Ling Yuan's investigation through other means, such as creating false leads to divert attention.
choices.visible_reward: Retain Heavenly Fate while resolving the crisis
choices.risk_hint: If the plan fails, Ling Yuan may seize upon evidence

text.content: Chen Ji contemplated for a moment, then shook his head: "No rush." He rose and walked to the window, his gaze fixed toward the distant Inner Sect. "If Ling Yuan wants to investigate, let him. I want to see what he can find." His plan was simple—since both Ye Qing and Su Qingyao were secretly investigating Ling Yuan, he would let these forces constrain each other. He only needed to add fuel to the fire at the critical moment, then sit back and reap the benefits. Master Mo's voice drifted over: "You little one, your mind is quite meticulous. Very well, have it your way."

Outside the abandoned alchemical workshop on East Peak, the moonlight shone like frost. Chen Ji lay concealed behind a rock a hundred zhang away, breath held and spirit focused. After roughly the time it takes to burn a stick of incense, two figures arrived in succession. One was Ling Yuan; the other wore the distinctive black combat attire of the Xuanwu Sect, their aura沉凝 like an abyss. From such a great distance, Chen Ji couldn't hear what they were saying, but the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace grew faintly warm—it seemed to be capturing something. Just then, Ling Yuan suddenly raised his hand, and a burst of spiritual energy shot toward the direction where Chen Ji was hiding!

dialogue.content: "Who dares spy!" Ling Yuan's voice thundered like a sudden clap of thunder. "Show yourself!" Chen Ji's heart chilled, and just as he prepared to flee, a wisp of black mist surged from the shadows, wrapping around him entirely. The next instant, he appeared dozens of zhang away in a thicket of trees. Ye Qing's voice rang in his ear: "Fool, did you think a Foundation Building cultivator wouldn't detect you?" Her expression was ice-cold, but her tone carried a hint of irritation. "I told you to come after the Hour of the Rat. Who told you to eavesdrop early?"

text.content: Chen Ji was carried away by the black mist at tremendous speed, far from East Peak. Only when Ye Qing confirmed their pursuers hadn't followed did she release him. The two landed in a mountain valley, with no one else in sight. Chen Ji straightened his clothes, his expression calm: "Many thanks to the Saint for the rescue." Ye Qing stared at him coldly: "Don't celebrate too soon. Ling Yuan is already suspicious. Though your aura is concealed, he'll investigate from other directions." She paused, her tone softening slightly. "I came to tell you something—behind Ling Yuan stands a person from the Holy Sect." Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted: "Holy Sect?" Ye Qing nodded: "To be precise, it is the Holy Sect's 'Heavenly Eye.'"

dialogue.content: "Heavenly Eye?" Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly. Ye Qing took a deep breath and lowered her voice: "Within the Holy Sect exists a mysterious organization dedicated to surveilling the world's talented individuals. They recruit promising young people into their ranks; if one refuses..." She didn't finish, but the implication was obvious. Chen Ji picked up the thread: "If they refuse, they are eliminated." Ye Qing nodded: "When Ling Yuan was young, he was noticed by the Heavenly Eye, but he chose to submit rather than resist. Now he is a pawn of the Heavenly Eye within the Tianqing Sect." She looked at Chen Ji, her gaze complex. "And you... the Heavenly Eye has already noticed you."

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a long while. The night wind brushed past, swaying his clothes, yet could not disperse the heaviness between his brows. Heavenly Eye, Holy Sect, Ling Yuan... this chess game was far grander than he had imagined. And he, a mere废物 servant who only wished to survive, had already been drawn into the center of this maelstrom. He suddenly laughed—that smile carrying a hint of self-mockery: "It seems this waste persona can no longer be maintained indefinitely." Ye Qing slightly startled, then coldly snorted: "Did you think there was still a way back?" Chen Ji shook his head, his gaze deepening: "No path back means we can only move forward."

Ye Qing gazed at him steadily, and after a long while finally spoke: "You are very different from the rumors." Chen Ji raised an eyebrow: "What rumors?" Ye Qing's lips curved into a meaningful arc: "The rumors say you are the most worthless servant disciple in the Tianqing Sect, still lingering at Qi Refining Third Stage after ten years of cultivation." She paused, her gaze sharp as a blade. "But just now, when you were being pursued by Ling Yuan, your reactions were swift and your judgments precise—nothing a废物 could achieve." Chen Ji offered no defense, merely saying coolly: "What does the Saint wish to say?" Ye Qing met his eyes directly: "I want to know who you truly are."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji met her gaze, falling silent for several breaths. Under the moonlight, their shadows overlapped. He suddenly smiled—that smile shedding its former simpleness, revealing depth and mystery: "Who am I? A废物 servant of the Tianqing Sect, bearer of the incomplete Tianji Record, a chess piece observed by Heavenly Will..." His voice was low. "Which identity would the Saint like to hear?" A flash of surprise crossed Ye Qing's eyes, then transformed into intense interest: "Interesting." She extended her hand. "Whoever you are, I offer you a choice—cooperate with me."

text.content: Chen Ji did not immediately respond, but instead asked: "What benefit would cooperation bring you?" Ye Qing withdrew her hand, her expression turning stern: "The Holy Sect is riddled with factional conflicts. Though I am the Saint, I am merely a puppet. The Holy Sect uses me, and I wish to use the Holy Sect." Her gaze drifted into the distance. "Your Tianji Record can foresee the future. If you help me escape the Holy Sect's control, I am willing to assist you with Demonic Path secret arts." Chen Ji pondered: "You want me to help you deal with the Holy Sect?" Ye Qing shook her head: "No, to deal with the Heavenly Eye. The Heavenly Eye... is the Holy Sect's most dangerous assassin organization."

The night deepened; only the wind and their two breaths remained in the valley. After long deliberation, Chen Ji finally nodded: "Cooperation is possible, but I have one condition." Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: "Speak." Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried undeniable resolve: "Whatever happens, you must not harm the people I care about." Ye Qing gazed at him for a moment, then suddenly laughed lightly: "Someone so full of schemes，居然还有在意的人?" Chen Ji did not answer, merely looking at her quietly. Ye Qing's smile faded, and she extended her right hand: "Deal."

The two hands clasped under the moonlight, and the pact was thus sealed. Ye Qing released his hand and withdrew a black jade slip from her sleeve: "This is a communication token; if there's urgent business, inject spiritual energy into it." Chen Ji accepted the jade slip, then suddenly recalled something: "Why did you choose to appear at the Martial Arena tonight? Merely to test me?" Ye Qing slightly smiled—that smile appearing especially captivating under the moonlight: "Because I saw... possibility in you." She turned to leave, but after several steps stopped again. "By the way, the Xuanwu Sect emissary Ling Yuan met tonight is named Han Lie." Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted: Han Lie, the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, Ling Yuan's ally... or rival?

Ye Qing's figure vanished into the night. Chen Ji stood alone in the valley, his thoughts churning. Heavenly Eye, Holy Sect, Ling Yuan, Han Lie... multiple forces intertwined, and he stood precisely at the center of this web. What disturbed him even more was the Tianji Record's reaction—earlier at the alchemical workshop, the fragment had clearly captured something, yet it was interrupted by Ling Yuan's spiritual energy. He drew it out for a look. On the fragment appeared a line of faint, flickering text: "Heavenly Fate Lock and Key—the time of its appearance draws near." Chen Ji's heart lurched: Heavenly Fate Lock and Key... that was the name the Holy Sect mentioned when they took his sister Chen Nian. He gripped the fragment tightly, his knuckles white.
